items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview

ctx.x: '43. I got off from work that night with Eddie Heyward and went directly to the Capitol Theater, to the basement, and rehearsed all night, up to the first show. We did five shows that day. And at the end of that day, I was some kind of tired, and I went home. I went to sleep, had the alarm clock set. I haven't heard the alarm clock yet. I woke up about 5:00 o'clock that afternoon. I'd missed all of the shows. So Tricky Sam, Joe Nanton, he got a friend of his to replace me. And that's how I happened to work that…
The first -- the last day I opened and closed in one. So after that, was when I joined Raymond Scott at CBS.
